title: prepare_snapshot input
description: Input for `prepare_snapshot`. Same inputs after ref resolution produce the same snapshot id (§8.4) — `prepare_snapshot` is idempotent.

repos.description: `repo -> ref | sha` map. Refs resolved against the federation's mirror; shas passed through unchanged.

exclude.description: Repos to exclude from the snapshot (§8.4).

from.description: Snapshot id to derive from (§11). Derived snapshots inherit `join_config` and the un-overridden commits; they do NOT inherit failure. Mutually exclusive with `max_base_age_s`.

max_base_age_s.description: Reuse the newest `ready` record younger than this age for any repo not in `repos`. Only valid without `from` (§11).

wait_ms.description: Maximum time to wait for `ready`/`failed`. Defaults to 5,000 ms; capped at 60,000 ms (§10.5).
